exposure: Congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH) due to 21-hydroxylase deficiency
cohort: 272 women with CAH due to 21-hydroxylase deficiency and 27,200 matched controls from the Swedish National CAH Register, the Total Population Register, and the Medical Birth Register
finding: Women with CAH had a lower birth rate, fewer children, were slightly older at first birth, and had higher rates of gestational diabetes and cesarean section compared to controls.
mod_finding: The study found that women with CAH were more likely to have a cesarean section delivery compared to controls.
